findings.evidence: Lines 143 and 155 establish `hg : Integrable g ν` and `IsFiniteMeasure (ν.withDensity (ofReal ∘ g))`; Mathlib `Function/AEEqOfLIntegral.lean:211` provides `withDensity_eq_iff` for arbitrary `μ` when `∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ ≠ ∞`.
findings.fix: Remove `[SigmaFinite ν]` and replace the final `withDensity_eq_iff_of_sigmaFinite` use with `withDensity_eq_iff hmeasp hmeasn`, supplying finiteness of the positive density’s lintegral from `hg` (or the existing finite-measure instance).
findings.issue: `ae_eq_zero_of_forall_moment_eq_zero` assumes `[SigmaFinite ν]`, excluding arbitrary measures even though the proof establishes integrability of `g` and hence of both truncated densities.

summary: The function-level theorem unnecessarily requires the reference measure to be σ-finite, although its integrable density supplies the finite-lintegral condition needed for density uniqueness.
